title: Spoiler-Free Thoughts on GTA VI
summary: I'm about ten hours and I'm blown away
content:
I'm about ten hours in and I have some (completely unorganised) thoughts.

  • To my knowledge this is the first time a child of any sort has been shown in a GTA game.
  • There's a cameo from Stephen Ogg, who plays Trevor in GTA V, on the radio.
  • The way missions can be completed at different points now is much better than in previous games where if you kill someone at the wrong point in a mission it fails. There's also multiple cut scenes for some missions depending on how you do it — the prologue has three different sequences depending on how you do.
  • The way the police look for you now is so much more realistic — it's not enough to change your car, you need to change your appearance or get far enough away. It's interesting how much this changes how I play.
  • Running out of petrol is a new stress I absolutely wasn't ready for.
  • Not a fan of the "store your cash at home so it doesn't get nicked if you die" system. Seems like pissing about for no benefit.
  • The NPC interaction is the best I've ever seen in any game.
  • The map is huge. Like, bonkers huge.
  • It's great to have a photo mode (I don't recall if GTA V had this or not).
  • I can't tell if this is a parody of Florida or just an accurate representation. Is Florida even real?
